experiments.scope: Exact sha256-r37-prefix-v1 complete hash on 55-byte single-block messages prefix||u (52+3 bytes). Per organizer seed a 52-byte prefix; u runs over 0..31 (32 messages). 16-bit digest-xor mask on low 16 bits of words H3 and H7. Trial 0 runs one counted eight-lane SWAR batch (2736 word ops) and compares all eight digests to the inlined scalar reference on eight diverse u values. All 256 trials returned.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned mask matches are genuine on the trusted digest function. Mask collision rate at N_t=32 and w=16 is consistent with the independent-uniform pair model used in heuristic H1 (supporting evidence only).

experiments.scope: Same target and message shape; one prefix per seed with u=0..511 (512 consecutive inner values). Same 16-bit mask on H3/H7 low halves. Trial 0: eight-lane SWAR batch op lock 2736 and scalar digest cross-check on eight diverse u values as in cigts-mask-spread.
experiments.hypothesis: Within-group consecutive u values do not show excess or deficit of masked agreements relative to the uniform random-function model at w=16.
